brief: Disclosures for vTv Therapeutics trial NCT03980730 (Elevage, azeliragon in mild Alzheimer's disease with impaired glucose tolerance, phase 2, terminated; registry reason 'for business reasons'; primary completion 2020-12-01, completion 2021-01-29). Find what vTv told investors in 8-Ks about this trial near when it stopped. Quote the 8-K language exactly and say whether it gives a reason.

findings.claim: On November 5, 2020, in an 8-K filing (exhibit 99.1), vTv Therapeutics stated: "Following our decision to conclude enrollment in the Elevage Study at the end of September, we look forward to announcing topline results from this phase 2 study of azeliragon in December". This passage names the trial (Elevage Study) and gives no reason for concluding enrollment.
findings.notes: Filing states enrollment concluded on September 30, 2020.

findings.claim: On November 24, 2020, in an 8-K filing (exhibit 99.1), vTv Therapeutics stated: "finalizing and reporting topline results from the Company's ongoing Elevage Study of azeliragon for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease in patients with type 2 diabetes in December 2020". This passage names the trial (Elevage Study) and gives no reason.
findings.notes: Mentions ongoing status and expected December 2020 results in the context of financing.

findings.claim: On February 24, 2021, in an 8-K filing (exhibit 99.1), vTv Therapeutics stated: "On December 15, 2020, vTv announced that the phase 2 Elevage Study of azeliragon did not meet its primary objective. vTv has discontinued development of azeliragon for Alzheimer's disease, but the Company is evaluating potential alternative indications in partnership with other interested parties." This passage names the trial (Elevage Study) and gives efficacy as the reason (did not meet its primary objective).
findings.notes: Announces trial did not meet its primary objective and development was discontinued.
